sectionPath: GENERAL PROVISIONS FOR AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES
primaryBlock.normalizedText:
Unless specified by the appropriate ATS authority, voice readback of controller-pilot data link
communications (CPDLC) messages shall not be required.
